answer: Submissions that land within 196 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. A farm scripting its whole farm fires them together, and hence the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 240 aliases out burns the operator real scheduling effort per key.
